description: Dept. of Local Government - N. W. P - Notice under section 66 (c) Appointed Chairman, Vice Chairman, Mayor and Deputy Mayor for 14 Local Government Institutions.
reasoning: This gazette announces election results and appointments of elected officials (Mayors/Chairmen and Deputy Mayors/Vice Chairmen) for local government institutions in North Western Province, specifically under the Local Government Institutes Elections Ordinance. This falls squarely under electoral processes and declarations, making it an Elections Gazette.
